baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restriction in innama ad'u, followed by la ushriku bihi ahadan.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling is confined to the Lord, while negated partnership plus exhaustive ahad closes every possible co-recipient slot.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech to draw near supplies the focus act and makes its recipient the mechanism's hinge.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the sole endpoint to which the call is directed.
Sharing and partnership supply the relation explicitly barred from the act of invocation.
Exhaustive anyone under negation extends the exclusion from one rival to every eligible participant.

changed_reading.before: A personal statement that the speaker worships his Lord and avoids association.
changed_reading.after: A total recipient boundary: the call draws toward the Lord alone and leaves no share for any co-recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive relation in rabbi within ad'u rabbi.
baseline_models.mechanism: The invoked Lord is not only a sovereign title but the one who repairs, nurtures, and brings the caller toward completion; my marks dependence on that care, not control over it.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing formative relation rather than a bare label.
Ownership and authority keep the formative relation asymmetrical: the caller depends on the Lord.
The near-drawing call turns that lordship relation into an enacted appeal.

changed_reading.before: Rabbi is a generic divine title naming the object of prayer.
changed_reading.after: Rabbi names the sole authority whose continuing care forms the caller, so invocation enacts dependence on nurture and completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative qul externalizes the first-person confession that follows.
baseline_models.mechanism: A held doctrine becomes mandated utterance: the speaker must make the non-partnership boundary audible rather than keep it as an inward conviction.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the public medium through which the focus stance must be exposed.
Speech as belief or doctrine lets the imperative carry a held position into public articulation.
Partnership supplies the social relation that the uttered boundary refuses.
Exhaustive anyone gives the public refusal universal scope.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an inwardly held monotheistic conviction.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs a required public boundary, audibly refusing every negotiated share in invocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus command to speak is downstream of hidden disclosure, attentive reception, and recitable content, so its authority is receptive and relay-like rather than self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the revised model in the focus imperative.
Knowledge cast in hidden fashion supplies disclosure prior to the speaker's public utterance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns reception into the prerequisite for faithful relay.
Reading and recitation supply formed verbal content that can pass from reception into speech.

structural_cues: 72:1 opens with the same imperative and sequences disclosure, attentive hearing, and the hearers' report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden disclosure, hearing-as-compliance, recitation, and the repeated imperative. I infer that the focus voice derives authority by relaying received content; a live alternative is that qul only frames a formula without specifying a general speech ethic.

changed_reading.before: Qul simply makes a private conviction public.
changed_reading.after: Qul commissions a received statement: the speaker's authority lies in faithful transmission, not independent authorship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus utterance stands against speech falsely attributed to God, speech that crosses its limit, and outright falsehood; saying becomes an accountable boundary practice.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the focus act whose truth conditions are sharpened by context.
False saying or attribution supplies the nearby corrupt counterpart to commanded truthful speech.
Excessive crossing of a limit marks what speech about God must not do.
Falsehood as the opposite of truth supplies the explicit failure that the focus saying resists.

structural_cues: 72:4-5 repeat saying about God and qualify it as boundary-crossing and false before 72:20 is commanded as saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, excess, and falsehood in prior speech about God. I assign those scenes a contrastive arrow into the focus imperative; a live alternative is that they condemn earlier speakers without defining every function of qul in 72:20.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is merely ordered to announce his devotional allegiance.
changed_reading.after: The speaker is ordered to make a tightly bounded claim that neither invents for God nor exceeds what can be truthfully said.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failed refuge with non-divine agents increases burden, while no protector can shield the speaker from God and no side refuge can be found; exclusive invocation reroutes protective reliance to the Lord rather than outsourcing it.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near supplies the focus action through which reliance is rerouted.
Lordship and authority identify the relation that displaces rival protection networks.
Partnership supplies the prohibited distribution of reliance among multiple agents.
Protective recourse supplies the failed alternative channel against which exclusive calling is read.
Increase and growth supply the directional result: the attempted refuge amplifies rather than relieves the condition.
Burdensome imposition names what the rival refuge increases.
Protective neighborhood or pledged shelter supplies the protection the speaker denies anyone can provide against God.
Leaning toward a refuge supplies the lateral escape route that the speaker cannot find.

structural_cues: 72:6 makes refuge in other agents worsen the burden, and 72:22 denies both shielding from God and an alternate refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed refuge, increased burden, and the later denial of protective or lateral escape. I infer that the focus call positively reroutes dependence rather than only naming a ritual recipient; a live alternative is the narrower reading of invocation as worship without a protection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse excludes other objects from a ritual act of prayer.
changed_reading.after: The verse dismantles a protection network: reliance is called back from burden-producing intermediaries to the Lord alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plural, divergent tracks are followed by straightness on the path and then by testing, turning away, remembrance, and being routed into consequence; exclusive calling functions as maintenance of a single alignment under trial.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near anchors route maintenance in the focus act of directed approach.
Refused partnership prevents the directed act from being distributed across competing alignments.
An extended path supplies the spatial substrate on which communal difference is pictured.
Divergent paths and factions pluralize the available alignments that the focus refuses to combine.
Straightness and balance supply the corrective posture toward a single route.
The extended path supplies the route on which straightness is sustained.
Testing a person or metal makes continued alignment a condition exposed under pressure.
Turning one's side supplies the movement away from maintained orientation.
Remembrance running on the tongue connects verbal practice to continued orientation toward the Lord.
Penetrating along a path supplies the consequential routing that follows turning away.

structural_cues: 72:11 names divergent paths; 72:16-17 narrows to straightness on the path, abundance as test, and the consequence of turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural paths, straightness, testing, turning away, voiced remembrance, and consequential routing. I infer that exclusive invocation helps maintain one alignment through the test; a live alternative is that the path sequence governs conduct broadly without specifically defining prayer.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive invocation identifies one recipient rather than several.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive invocation also acts as route discipline, repeatedly aligning the caller toward one Lord while plural tracks and tests pull elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: A God-owned worship space, a prohibition on co-invocation, a servant standing to call, and a crowd piling around him turn the focus confession into a public recipient boundary maintained under collective density.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the focus boundary audible inside the public scene.
Calling to draw near anchors the scene's contested action in the focus.
Exhaustive anyone keeps crowd size from opening even one co-recipient position.
A place of prostration supplies the God-owned setting in which address is regulated.
Calling to draw near supplies the general prohibition immediately preceding the speaker's particular confession.
Exhaustive anyone makes the preceding plural prohibition coextensive with the focus refusal.
Submissive worship identifies the standing caller by service rather than social dominance.
Calling to draw near repeats the focus action at the center of the crowd scene.
A piled, overlapping multitude supplies the horizontal pressure around the singularly directed call.

structural_cues: 72:18-20 moves from a plural prohibition, through the standing servant and piled crowd, to an imperative first-person confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a regulated worship setting, a servant's call, and a piled multitude immediately before the focus. I infer that the confession maintains recipient integrity under crowd pressure; a live alternative is that the crowd gathers in eager attention rather than opposition or coercion.

changed_reading.before: The speaker privately states whom he invokes.
changed_reading.after: The speaker voices a non-negotiable address boundary in public: collective proximity cannot become partnership in the call.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate denial of possessing harm or right direction for the audience prevents my Lord and exclusive invocation from becoming a claim of delegated control, mediation, or guaranteed outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near anchors the dependence that must be distinguished from possessing outcomes.
Lordship and authority locate control with the Lord rather than with the caller.
Possession and disposal supply the agency explicitly denied to the speaker.
Harm and loss supply one class of outcome the speaker cannot dispense.
Sound handling and right action supply the beneficial outcome the speaker likewise cannot own for others.

structural_cues: 72:21 immediately follows the exclusive invocation statement with another qul and a first-person denial of power over the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the denial of possession over both harmful and rightly directing outcomes. I infer that this qualifies the focus possessive and exclusivity as dependence rather than proxy authority; a live alternative is that 72:21 limits only particular outcomes without addressing every kind of mediation.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive access to my Lord could sound like a claim to privileged control on the audience's behalf.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive invocation is a confession of dependence: the caller neither owns the Lord nor controls harm, benefit, or guidance for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: After denying power, the speaker retains delivery from God and His messages as his positive scope; the final accounting of delivered messages confirms that the commanded voice is bounded by transmission.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the mandate whose permitted scope is defined by delivery.
Conveying a message supplies the positive task left after the speaker denies control.
Messenger and message supply the commission whose content the focus utterance carries.
Completed message delivery supplies the closing criterion by which the voice's task is measured.
The closing messages reconnect successful delivery to the messenger role rather than autonomous authority.

structural_cues: 72:21-23 moves from denied power to the exception of delivery, while 72:28 closes by verifying that the messages were delivered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied power, message delivery, messenger identity, and closing verification. I infer that these define the functional perimeter of qul; a live alternative is that the exception in 72:23 has a narrower syntactic attachment, though delivery still remains the adjacent positive commission.

changed_reading.before: Qul authorizes a forceful personal declaration.
changed_reading.after: Qul authorizes only accountable transmission: the speaker's strength is reaching the addressee with the message, not adding power or content of his own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker disclaims knowledge of timing; unseen knowledge remains concealed unless God discloses it to a chosen messenger, guards its route, and completely encompasses and counts the delivery. Exclusive invocation therefore does not create unsupervised occult access.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the epistemically bounded statement in the focus command.
Calling to draw near anchors the relation that must not be mistaken for unrestricted knowledge access.
Knowledge and discernment supply the capacity the speaker explicitly leaves uncertain.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the protected knowledge domain that belongs to God.
Emergence and disclosure supply the controlled transition from hidden knowledge to what a messenger may receive.
Approval and acceptance supply the selection condition for disclosure.
Messenger and message supply the authorized human endpoint of selective disclosure.
Watchful guarding supplies protection around the disclosure and delivery route.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies divine oversight of what is with the messengers.
Exact enumeration and exhaustive accounting supply the audit boundary around delivery.

structural_cues: 72:25-28 moves from the speaker's uncertainty to selective disclosure, guards before and behind the messenger, and complete divine accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human uncertainty, hidden knowledge, selective disclosure, guarding, and exhaustive oversight. I infer that the focus relation grants a commissioned channel but not autonomous access; a live alternative is that the guards protect the message specifically rather than qualifying every utterance or prayer.

changed_reading.before: Exclusive calling to my Lord could imply privileged access to divine secrets.
changed_reading.after: Exclusive calling remains epistemically humble: whatever is spoken arrives through a selected, guarded, and fully audited disclosure channel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the path-rut branch of sh-r-k rather than its direct partnership sense. It remains anchored in focus ushriku and gains visible support from divergent paths followed by straightness on the path. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain spatial resonance, never as a replacement for the lexical prohibition of association.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb ushriku, read through its branch image of rutted and branching tracks.

activation_trace.role: Road ruts and main tracks supply an exploratory spatial image for invocation that refuses to branch.
An extended path supplies the same spatial domain elsewhere in the packet.
Divergent paths and factions make branching a live contextual image rather than an isolated pun.
Straightness and balance supply the counter-motion to branching.
The singular extended path supplies the route on which the caller remains aligned.

changed_reading.before: I do not assign a partner in my invocation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, I do not let invocation split into rival ruts; it stays on one directed route to my Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because focus q-w-l reaches q-l-l only through the packet's non-dominant split mapping, not through the ordinary speech target. It remains formally anchored in focus qul and is reactivated by fewer supporters and number in 72:24. Downstream prose must label it a packet-authorized split-root resonance, not claim that qul lexically means fewness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus qul under the packet's non-dominant mapped target root_001251.

activation_trace.role: Fewness and smallness supply the packet-authorized but form-distant resonance attached to the command qul.
Explicit fewness supplies the nearby reactivation of the non-dominant focus mapping.
Support and aid identify what may prove weak around the speaker's declaration.
Counting the numbered supplies the numerical field in which fewness becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Qul is solely the command to utter the confession.
changed_reading.after: Very tentatively, the command is also heard as speech built to stand when supporters and numbers are few.

strongest_changes: Exclusive invocation became a rerouting of protective reliance away from burden-producing intermediaries.
The imperative became received, truth-bounded, and accountable delivery rather than autonomous religious speech.
The 72:18-20 sequence turned a private confession into a public recipient boundary maintained amid a piled crowd.
The immediate denial of power in 72:21 stripped my Lord of any implication that the caller owns outcomes or acts as a controlling proxy.
The closing disclosure sequence made exclusive calling compatible with uncertainty and subordinate to a guarded, fully audited knowledge channel.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse sits at the hinge between a crowded invocation scene and a cascade of denials about power, refuge, knowledge, and authorship. That placement converts a short confession into disciplined address: singular in recipient, public under pressure, dependent rather than controlling, and bounded by delivery.
remaining_uncertainties: The piled crowd in 72:19 may signal opposition, eager gathering, or both, so crowd resistance should not be overstated.
The exact syntactic reach of the delivery exception in 72:23 remains open even though delivery is clearly the nearby positive commission.
The route and fewness outliers are branch resonances, not lexical replacements, and require explicit exploratory qualification.
